params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.

params.name: search_semantics
params.description: How to interpret the search input.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to items published after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to items published before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to items modified after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to items modified before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: status
params.description: Limit result set to items assigned one or more statuses. Anonymous callers may only request `publish`.

params.name: author
params.description: Limit result set to posts assigned to specific authors.

params.name: author_exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes posts assigned to specific authors.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific category terms (1 = Company News, 7 = Press Releases).

params.name: categories_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific category terms.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific tag terms. The post_tag taxonomy is empty on this deployment.

params.name: tags_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific tag terms.

params.name: tax_relation
params.description: Limit result set based on relationship between multiple taxonomies.

params.name: sticky
params.description: Limit result set to items that are sticky.

params.name: ignore_sticky
params.description: Whether to ignore sticky posts.

params.name: format
params.description: Limit result set to items assigned one or more given formats.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by post attribute.

items.docs: Lists published posts. On this deployment the collection is the company's blog/news archive — 10 items spanning January 2023 (the $130 million debut and the Genentech collaboration) through June 2024 (the Sanofi immunology collaboration), including press coverage in Endpoints News, Fierce Pharma, C&EN and the Timmerman Report. Paginated; `X-WP-Total` and `X-WP-TotalPages` are exposed via `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the object.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

params.name: password
params.description: The password for the post if it is password protected.

items.docs: Retrieves one published post by its numeric ID.
